events.name: Pinktober Brunch: Rocking for a Cure
events.info: Join us at Hard Rock Cafe Washington, DC for a special Pinktober Brunch supporting the fight against breast cancer. Enjoy a delicious brunch, live performance by recent The Voice contestant Marilyn Hucek, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. A portion of proceeds will benefit Hard Rock Cafe Washington, DC's Making Strides Against Breast Cancer Team, honoring our beloved line cook, Hilda, while supporting the mission of the American Cancer Society. Your Ticket Includes: Choice of one brunch entree: Avocado Flatbread Mozzarella, Roasted Tomato, Lime Crema, Queso Fresco, Pickled Red Onion & Arugula Brioche & Bourbon French Toast Brown Butter Streusel, Macerated Strawberries, Bourbon Maple & Fresh Whipped Cream Brunch Burger Classic Smashed Patty, American Cheese, Bacon, Over Easy Egg, Crispy Hash Potatoes, Hollandaise, Served with Seasoned Fries* Ultimate Breakfast Sandwich Toasted Bun, American Cheese, Sausage, Bacon, Smoked Ham, Garlic Aioli & Tomato Scallion Soufflé, served with Seasoned Fries One complimentary mimosa An exclusive 2026 Pinktober Breast Cancer Awareness Pin Live entertainment and community celebration Gather with friends, family, and the community as we celebrate strength, hope, and survivorship while raising funds for an important cause. Together, we can make strides toward a world without breast cancer.

events.name: GLOW Block Party: Diplo
events.info: We're heading back to Pennsylvania Ave for the second edition of the GLOW Block Party; featuring Grammy-winning DJ and producer Diplo, tech house star Westend, singer/DJ Anabel Englund, breakout Monty Kiddo, and a cast of some of the best homegrown talent DC has to offer. We can't wait to bring the iconic Pennsylvania Avenue to life for a one-day affair, where we turn one of DC's most legendary streets into the biggest party the city has ever seen. With a world-class stage layout that complements the surrounding buildings, local vendors providing the best bites and art the area has to offer, art installations, and so much more, for one night only the street becomes the dance floor. A destination mini-festival just steps from the Capitol, National Gallery of Art and National Archives, the second Club Glow Block Party is from 3-10pm. See you on Saturday, October 3rd, as we transform a storied DC neighborhood into a historic dance party.
